customMethods.name: saveLotOperation
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("saveLotOperation called")
	
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	lotOperationEventInfo = dict(self.view.custom.lotOperationEventInfo)
	if lotOperationEventInfo['tStamp'] is None: lotOperationEventInfo['tStamp'] = system.date.now()
	
	inputLotEvents = self.view.custom.inputLotEvents.data
	outputLotEvents = self.view.custom.outputLotEvents.data
	
	lotOperationEventId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.executeLotOperation(lotOperationEventInfo, inputLotEvents, outputLotEvents, userId)

	if msg:	system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'Lot Operation Event was not saved. %s'%msg})			
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Lot Operation Event has been saved'})			

	self.view.params.value.lotOperationEventId = lotOperationEventId

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.lotOperationEventInfo")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.inputLotEvents.data")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.outputLotEvents.data")
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('lotUpdate', {})
	payload = {'lotOperationEventId': lotOperationEventInfo['lotOperationEventId']}
	
	return

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("opAssetSelected() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	lotOperationEventInfo = dict(self.view.custom.lotOperationEventInfo)
	
	if len(payload['selection']) == 0: 
		lotOperationEventInfo['assetId'] = None
		lotOperationEventInfo['assetPath'] = None
	else:
		lotOperationEventInfo['assetId'] = payload['selection'][0]['value']['assetId'] if payload['selection'][0]['value'].has_key('assetId') else None
		lotOperationEventInfo['assetPath'] = payload['selection'][0]['value']['assetPath'] if payload['selection'][0]['value'].has_key('assetPath') else None

	self.view.custom.lotOperationEventInfo = lotOperationEventInfo
	
	return

system.perspective.print("sendOutputLotEvent() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	
	lotEventInfo = dict(payload['outputLotEventInfo'])
	if payload['serialId']:
		system.perspective.print("Calling getNextSerialNumber()")
		serialNumber, msg = system.kanoa.serial.getNextSerialNumber(payload['serialId'], userId)
		lotId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addLot({'lotName': serialNumber, 'itemId': lotEventInfo['itemId'], 'itemUnitId': lotEventInfo['itemUnitId']}, userId)
		system.perspective.print("addLot() returned %s %s"%(lotId, msg))
		if msg:	
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Unable to create new lot with name %s. %s'%(serialNumber, msg)})
			return

		lotEventInfo['lotName'] = serialNumber
		lotEventInfo['lotId'] = lotId

	system.perspective.print("lotEventInfo['lotName'] %s lotEventInfo['lotId'] %s"%(lotEventInfo['lotName'], lotEventInfo['lotId'] ))

	if lotEventInfo['lotEventId'] is None:
		self.view.custom.outputLotEvents.data.append(lotEventInfo)
	else:
		for i, outputLotEvent in enumerate(self.view.custom.outputLotEvents.data):
			if outputLotEvent['lotEventId'] == lotEventInfo['lotEventId']:
				self.view.custom.outputLotEvents.data[i] = lotEventInfo
				break
	
	self.saveLotOperation()

	return
